name: ZENTECH
recent: Zen Tech 近期完成私募配售定价每股 RM0.0045，同时因诽谤诉讼被判赔偿前董事经理 RM200,000，外部审计师因审计费未付而辞职。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收环比增长10%但同比下滑17.1%，净亏损116.8万令吉。
notable: 完成私募配售定价，每股 RM0.0045，较 VWAP 折价 10%。
因诽谤诉讼被判向前董事经理 Mohd Anuar 赔偿 RM200,000。
外部审计师因审计费未付而辞职。
risks: 私募配售新股可能摊薄现有股东权益。
公司涉及重大诉讼，被判赔偿 RM200,000。
外部审计师辞职，可能影响财务报告审计。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收 1,134.1万令吉，环比增长10.0%，同比下滑17.1%；净亏损 116.8万令吉，净亏损率 10.3%，较上季度的 96.1% 亏损率收窄。

recent_en: Zen Tech recently fixed its private placement issue price at RM0.0045 per share, was ordered to pay RM200,000 in defamation damages to a former managing director, and its external auditor resigned over unpaid audit fees. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 10% QoQ but fell 17.1% YoY, with a net loss of RM1.168 million.
notable_en: Fixed the private placement issue price at RM0.0045 per share, a 10% discount to VWAP.
Ordered to pay RM200,000 in defamation damages to former managing director Mohd Anuar.
External auditor resigned over unpaid audit fees.
risks_en: The private placement of new shares may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
The company is involved in material litigation and was ordered to pay RM200,000 in damages.
The external auditor's resignation may affect financial statement audits.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM11.341 million, up 10.0% QoQ but down 17.1% YoY; net loss was RM1.168 million with a net margin of -10.3%, narrowing from -96.1% in the previous quarter.
